description:
In a nutshell

At Picnic, we're building the most secure milkman on earth. Our Security team owns the security tooling that protects Picnic, and we're looking for a Java Engineer to make it work everywhere: connecting our systems to those tools, automating checks across the whole company, and strengthening how we manage identity and access.
You'll be the engineer in the Security team. Instead of writing policies, you'll write the code that wires our security systems into the rest of Picnic, and you'll help product teams do the right thing by default.

Tricks of the trade

  • Ownership: Take ownership of projects from concept to delivery, aligning technical solutions with business goals with a product engineering mindset.
  • Platform work: Own Picnic’s core Security and IAM platform services, and build integrations with internal and external services.
  • Identity & Access: Help take our IAM initiative from MVP to production. Look at the options, build or integrate the pieces and connect them to the systems Picnic runs on.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with development teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.
  • Security Ambassador: Conduct application security workshops to raise awareness and promote secure coding practices among developers.
  • Our Tech: Java 21/25 (Spring 6 with Spring Boot 3.5, Reactor, Immutables, Maven), React, Angular, RabbitMQ, Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Git, Docker, AWS, Helm, Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault, Datadog, Python 3.x

We’re looking for

  • You have a Master’s Degree (in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related technical field) or equivalent experience.
  • You have at least 3-7 years of professional experience with Java.
  • A genuine curiosity about security: experience isn’t required, but you’re excited to dive into topics like access control and to grow into the domain with us.
  • Your English skills are on point (no Dutch required).
  • You're based in or happy to relocate to the Netherlands*

    For bonus points:
  • Experience with Security frameworks like NIST, CIS Controls
  • Working experience in IAM integrations

We work from our office in Amsterdam. Being present makes a genuine difference to your team and the work. There's flexibility to work from home when needed, but if remote or hybrid-first is what you're after, this probably isn't the right fit.

Picnic Perks

✍🏼 Every expert was once a beginner!

You’ll get plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself and grow, including the Picnic Tech Academy, Lunch & Learn sessions, and tailored soft skills training. We also offer free professional weekly language courses.

💡 Make a difference

You’ll work in an awesome startup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact. Our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place!

🫱🏼‍🫲🏾 Teamwork makes the dream work

With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings to after-work drinks to our company ski trip and more!

🍎 You are what you eat

You’ll get freshly prepared, healthy lunches and snacks (with plenty of vegetarian, vegan, and halal options). Coffee snob? Don’t worry, our amazing Picnic barista has you covered.

🚴🏽 Stay healthy

Mental health is important. As well as having the option to speak with Picnic colleagues who act as confidential advisors, our collaboration with OpenUp gives you easy access to professional psychologists, along with workshops and materials. There are plenty of sports communities and events to get involved with, from tennis to yoga, to climbing!

🔋 Attractive package

We offer competitive compensation and a pension plan that looks out for your future self, as well as 25 vacation days per year, so you can recharge your batteries

🌍 Benefits for expats

It can be daunting starting a new job AND moving to a new country. That’s why we offer lots of support for our many expat colleagues, if you want to find our relocation benefits, see here.

description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Worum es geht Als Associate Business Engineer bei Enpal Energy verantwortest du einen der geschäftskritischsten Bereiche des Unternehmens: die Anbindung unserer Kund:innen an unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Damit das funktioniert, müssen tausende Prozesse mit Netzbetreibern, Messstellenbetreibern und weiteren Marktpartnern über die Marktkommunikation (MaKo) sauber laufen. Genau dort setzt du an. Das Regelwerk ist komplex und die Realität sieht oft anders aus. Du übersetzt regulatorische Vorgaben in pragmatische, automatisierte Prozesse, die im echten Betrieb funktionieren. Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech und verantwortest nicht nur, was du baust, sondern auch die Zahlen, die dabei herauskommen. Deine Aufgaben AI-Entwicklung am Puls der Zeit: Du nutzt die neuesten AI-Modelle, um extrem komplexe Geschäftsprozesse aufzubauen und zu automatisieren. So entwickelst du ein analytisches und operatives Skillset, das weit über klassische Business- oder Tech-Rollen hinausgeht und dich optimal für die sich wandelnde Arbeitswelt aufstellt. Ownership für deine Domäne: Du verantwortest einen Teilbereich unserer Onboarding-Prozesse End-to-End, von der Problemanalyse über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Die zugehörigen KPIs gehören dazu. Regulatorik pragmatisch übersetzen: Du analysierst Prozesse der Marktkommunikation, erkennst, wo Regelwerk und Realität auseinanderlaufen, und leitest daraus Logiken ab, die in der Praxis funktionieren. Tools bauen: Du entwickelst Entscheidungslogiken und eigene Tools für unsere Marktprozesse. Ein Beispiel ist unser selbst gebautes Portal, über das Netzbetreiber Klärfälle strukturiert mit uns klären. KPIs im Griff: Du baust Monitoring und Dashboards, erkennst Abweichungen früh und gehst ihnen auf den Grund, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Stakeholder treiben: Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Teams zusammen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Fehler dort behoben werden, wo sie entstehen, auch wenn das mehrere Schritte vor dir in der Prozesskette ist. Are you interested, even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential — regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️ What we offer Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition. The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities. The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities. Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee. Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you. Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress. The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events. Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance. Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step. Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home. At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. We do not make decisions based on skin color, religion or religious beliefs, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age—neither during the hiring process nor throughout the employment relationship.
